title: Traceable receipt (v1)
description: One checked action. hash = sha256 over canonical JSON of the array ["traceable-receipt", id, seq, at, kind, decision, runId, actionHash, ledgerRowHash, prevHash]; signature = the agent key over the 32 hash bytes. prevHash of the first receipt is 64 zeros.

kind.description: held, released and rejected have meaning for the Record Score; others are the writer's.

actionHash.description: sha256 of the action's subject and input, kept by the owner; null when there was none.
